title: Nesting at exactly maxDepth expands fully
rationale: The cliff edge from below. maxDepth is documented nowhere as inclusive or exclusive; this pins that maxDepth==M expands, so the setting means "number of map levels fully expanded". If that meaning shifts by one, every user data silently changes shape at the boundary.
catchesBugClass: Inclusive/exclusive drift in the maxDepth bound - the single most likely silent regression, because it changes output shape only for documents sitting exactly at the configured limit.
cannotCatch: It cannot tell you whether maxDepth SHOULD be inclusive; it only pins that it currently is. It also says nothing about what happens past the cliff.

predicted.detail: Three map levels, deepest flattenObject runs at depth 2, the check does not fire, and the exact three-level structure rebuilds.
